import torch, ctypes, subprocess, time, b200probe
t=time.time()
r=subprocess.run('nvcc -O3 -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC -o /tmp/tc.so /tmp/tc.cu -lcuda', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print('compile', round(time.time()-t,1), r.returncode, r.stderr[-1500:])
lib=ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/tc.so'); f=lib.tc_launch
f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*3+[ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p]
def call(emb,W,bias,*outs, hint=1, tf=0, ms=16):
    arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
    st=f(emb.data_ptr(),W.data_ptr(),bias.data_ptr(),arr,emb.shape[0],hint,tf,ms,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
    assert st==0, st
torch.manual_seed(0)
W=torch.randn(18432,3072,device='cuda')/3072**0.5; bias=torch.randn(18432,device='cuda')
for B in [5,16,32,96,128,131,192,211,256]:
    emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device='cuda')
    outs=[torch.zeros(B,3072,device='cuda') for _ in range(6)]
    ref=(emb.double()@W.double().T+bias.double())
    res=[]
    for tf in [0,1]:
        for o in outs: o.zero_()
        call(emb,W,bias,*outs,tf=tf); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        got=torch.cat(outs,1).double(); err=(got-ref).abs().max().item(); res.append(err)
    print(B, 'maxerr f32map %.3e tf32map %.3e'%tuple(res), 'frac>tol', ((got-ref).abs() > 2e-3+1e-5*ref.abs()).double().mean().item())
